description:
The canonical confirmation freezer copies the pilot addendum's family description into the confirmation unless the caller restates it, so a frozen confirmation can describe itself as the pilot.

## Background

`dev/active/c7113c5a/survey/freeze-confirmation.py` derives a confirmation addendum from a committed pilot receipt. Its `--family-description` option restates the family prose; without it the confirmation carries the pilot's description verbatim. The 1c602857 confirmation addendum ends with the pilot's own stage sentence ("This addendum is the pilot: every cell is exploratory") while every cell carries the `confirmatory` role, which the research-review gate reported as an advisory finding in two rounds. The receipt pins the frozen bytes, so the committed addendum stays as evidence; the defect is the freezer default.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The freezer refuses to write a confirmation addendum whose family description names the pilot stage or exploratory cells, unless the caller restates the description; the refusal names the offending sentence.
- [hard] REQ-02: The derivation record states the family description the confirmation carries and whether it was restated or inherited.
- [hard] REQ-03: The freezer's own tests cover the refusal and the restatement path, and every committed confirmation addendum frozen after this change validates against the rule.

## Notes

Surfaced by the 1c602857 research review (advisory A1). Committed addenda frozen before this change keep their bytes; their receipts pin them.
title: Freeze confirmation addenda with stage-specific family prose
